en: A vintage Swiss postal stationery card with a printed red 10-centime Swiss stamp at left and multilingual heading 'Carte postale.' with references to the Universal Postal Union in French, German, and Italian. The card is addressed in black ink in Russian to St. Petersburg, Russia. There are several postal cancellations, including circular date stamps from Montreux and Caux/Les Planches, as well as a blue circular Russian arrival postmark. A purple vertical handstamp at the right reads 'Hotel-Pension Vautier MONTREUX (Suisse)'.
